name: effect-radial-flash
title: Radial Flash
description: Ngôi sao loé sáng và nảy nhẹ, một vòng sóng toả ra cùng mười hai tia hai màu bắn ra rồi tắt.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio radial-flash, written here): Hit at t0: core brightness 100 → 220 % → 100 (sine bump^0.7 over 320 ms) with an additive soft glow; the star pops: scale 1 + 0.14·e^(−7 t)·sin(22 t), first half-wave only. From 60 ms a ring: radius 0.2 → 2.3 × 40 px, opacity 0.9 → 0, stroke 4 → 1 px, 500 ms expo.out. 12 rays in two colours move out (30→60 to 36→88 px) and fade over 350 ms expo.out. Params: core (100 → 220 %) · ring (0.2 → 2.3 × 40 px) · rays (12) · duration (0.56 s). Call once per hit.
